👩‍🍳✨ A Little Taste of the Baking World! 🧁🥐

As part of our Community Helpers Month, our little learners stepped into the world of baking and discovered what happens behind the scenes! 💛

From meeting the bakers to watching ingredients come together, exploring the baking process, and getting a closer look at how delicious treats are created — every moment was filled with curiosity, excitement and learning. 👀🍰

Because the best learning happens when little hands, curious minds and real-world experiences come together! 🌟

Learning beyond the classroom. Growing through experiences. ❤️
